# Offer letter outline

Use the company's own template when it has one. Otherwise use this outline and mark every candidate-specific value as a placeholder in angle brackets.

## Letter

1. **Date and greeting.** `<DATE>` in the profile's date format. "Dear `<CANDIDATE NAME>`,"
2. **The offer.** "We are pleased to offer you the position of `<TITLE>` at `<COMPANY>`, reporting to `<MANAGER TITLE>`, starting on `<START DATE>`."
3. **Where and how.** Work location or remote arrangement, working pattern, employment type (full-time, part-time, fixed-term).
4. **Pay.** Base pay `<AMOUNT>` in `<CURRENCY>` per `<PERIOD>`, pay frequency, and any bonus with how it is earned.
5. **Equity, if any.** Number of units, type, vesting schedule, cliff, and where the full plan terms are found.
6. **Benefits.** The main benefits, with a pointer to the full benefits documents.
7. **Conditions.** For example: right-to-work verification, background or reference checks where lawful, signing the employment agreement and confidentiality terms.
8. **Probation and notice.** Only as set by the company and local law. Flag for legal review.
9. **Acceptance.** How to accept and by when: "Please confirm by `<DEADLINE>`."
10. **Closing.** A short welcome in the company's voice. Signature block for the authorized person.

## Total compensation summary

| Component | Amount | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base pay | `<AMOUNT>` | Per year |
| Target bonus | `<PERCENT>` of base = `<AMOUNT>` | If applicable |
| Signing bonus | `<AMOUNT>` | One-time, if applicable |
| Equity | `<UNITS>` vesting over `<YEARS>` | Value basis stated, or "not valued" |
| First-year total | Sum of the above | Show the arithmetic |

## Clauses that always need local legal review

- Employment-at-will language (United States only, and not every state treats it the same way).
- Overtime or exempt status.
- Probation length, notice periods and termination terms.
- Non-compete, non-solicit and invention assignment terms (unenforceable or restricted in some places).
- Statutory benefits, leave entitlements and mandatory statements.
- Any condition involving background or criminal record checks.
